verdict.rationale: Circle publishes machine-readable OpenAPI YAML specs per product line at developers.circle.com/openapi/*.yaml, covering Gateway, CCTP, StableFX, CPN, user- and developer-controlled wallets, the Smart Contract Platform, compliance and xReserve. Every element of the story, a downloadable machine-readable API spec, is therefore directly evidenced. The probe's 404s hit only conventional single-file paths such as /openapi.json, so they do not contradict the per-product specs. Missing for 10: a single unified spec at a well-known path (the probed openapi.json and swagger.json paths returned 404), a documented index or download page listing the spec files, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
